## Canisphinx (CR 5)

This chimeric beast has the body of a tawny lion but the head and neck of a shaggy-haired jackal, with wide wings that are more bat-like than bird.  

**XP** 1,600  
NE Large magical beast  
**Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +10  


**Defense**


**AC** 18, touch 10, flat-footed 17 (+1 Dex, +8 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 57 (6d10+24)  
**Fort** +9, **Ref** +6, **Will** +7  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft., fly 80 ft. (poor)  
**Melee** bite +10 (2d8+7 plus grab)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
**Special Attacks** rake (2 claws +10, 2d6+5), roar  


**Statistics**


**Str** 21, **Dex** 13, **Con** 18, **Int** 15, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +12 (+16 grapple); **CMD** 23 (27 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Flyby Attack, Iron Will, Vital Strike  
**Skills** Fly +2, Intimidate +8, Knowledge (any one) +6, Perception +10, Survival +9  
**Languages** Common, Sphinx  


**Special Abilities**



**Roar (Su)** A canisphinx can roar up to three times per day as a standard action. Each progressive roar has a different effect, depending upon whether it is the first, second, or third of the canisphinx’s roars for that day. All of these roars are sonic effects that fill a 60-foot burst, centered on the canisphinx; the save DCs are Charisma-based. Sphinxes are immune to all of the effects of a canisphinx’s roars.  

**First Roar**: Affected creatures become frightened for 2d4 rounds (DC 15 Will negates). This is a mind-affecting fear effect in addition to being a sonic effect.  

**Second Roar**: Affected creatures are paralyzed 1 with fear for 1d4 rounds (DC 15 Will negates). This is a mind-affecting fear effect in addition to being a sonic effect.  

**Third Roar**: Affected creatures take 2d6 points of sonic damage and are paralyzed 1 and deafened for 2d6 rounds. A DC 15 Fortitude save halves the damage and negates the paralyzed and deafened conditions.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** warm deserts, hills, or plains  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** standard
